opening.argument: The presentation promotes KuCoin Shares as a source of daily rewards in multiple cryptocurrencies, stating that “I get daily rewarded all of the coins that KuCoin has under exchange.” It attributes those payments to trading-fee sharing based on the number of shares held, while discussing the purchase price and “imagine the profits” from appreciation. The description then directs viewers to sign up through a KuCoin referral link and separately advertises daily Bitcoin interest through lending and Bitcoin cloud mining through external referral-linked services. These are concrete return-oriented promotions seeking financial participation, although the available evidence does not establish that the rewards, services, or advertised outcomes were available to or received by viewers.
